column1: # Generated by `pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/pwsh_commands.ps1`; do not edit. build.rs turns it
# into static Rust slices; a test pins the generated code to this file.
# Copyright (c) Specter Contributors), flattened; the facts come from this machine's pwsh 7.
# Row kinds: cmdlet (a cmdlet or function), param, common, aka (an alias), variable, verb, dotnet.
# Columns are tab-separated. Rows sort by kind, then command.
#   cmdlet <name> <module> <type> <default set> <flags: B binds the common parameters, P also -WhatIf and -Confirm, R takes remaining arguments, S simple function>
#   common <name> <type> <aliases> <B: every cmdlet, P: only with flag P>
#   variable <name> <constant|readonly: assigning it fails; automatic: PowerShell overwrites it; session: set by the session>
#   dotnet <type, io.file or io.directory> <method> <path argument positions>
